headline: Greetings from Paris, where the 2024 Olympics balloon rises again
context: The floating Olympic cauldron, held aloft by a giant glowing balloon, is still making regular appearances two years after the 2024 Paris Games, showing up all summer long in the nighttime Paris sky.
